stages.text: Victoria Hand runs the Hub where Grant Ward takes his missions, and she brings him along to escort John Garrett to the Fridge.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Ward betrays Hand on the jump jet and shoots her dead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Grant Ward takes Werner von Strucker under his command in the new Hydra.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Maria Hill works with Nick Fury and Talos to stop Gravik's Skrull rebels. In Moscow, Gravik takes Fury's form and shoots her dead.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Gravik once worked for Nick Fury as a young Skrull spy and came to hate him for his broken promises. He now plots a war on Earth that Fury tries to stop.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Pagon is one of Gravik's top lieutenants and openly challenges him. Gravik kills him.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Raava is part of Gravik's rebel council and follows his plans to take over Earth.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Sonya Falsworth works with Nick Fury to stop Gravik's Skrull rebellion.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Soren is Talos's wife and an agent working against the rebels. Gravik kills her.

stages.title: Secret Invasion
stages.text: Talos once led the Skrulls who followed Nick Fury, including Gravik. Gravik turns against him, starts his own rebellion and kills him.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Jeri takes the serial killer Gregory Sallinger on as a client, which sets her against Jessica.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gregory Sallinger is a serial killer who murders Dorothy Walker and kidnaps Jessica. Jessica works to put him away, and Trish ends up killing him.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gregory Sallinger is a serial killer whom Malcolm helps Jessica try to bring to justice.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S3
stages.text: Gregory Sallinger murders Trish's mother, and Trish kills him for it.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Grill, the brutal manager of the Salvage in the future Lighthouse, employs May as a Trawler pilot hauling supplies. When his spy Zev reports on the team's secret trip, Grill threatens May and the others.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5
stages.text: Grill runs the salvage operation on the Lighthouse, and Coulson's group works for him.

stages.title: Hawkeye
stages.text: Grills, a firefighter and LARPer, lets Kate use his apartment and joins her and Clint against the Tracksuit Mafia.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2

stages.text: After Tony's death, Happy becomes one of Peter's closest allies and flies to London to help him.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel

stages.text: Ravonna Renslayer runs the TVA for the Time-Keepers, who are a front for He Who Remains.

stages.text: Sylvie spends her life running from the TVA and hunts down He Who Remains, its hidden creator, for taking her from her timeline. At the Citadel at the End of Time she ignores his warnings and kills him, splintering the timeline into a multiverse.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
stages.text: Heather Glenn questions Jack Duquesne in prison under the guise of being his psychiatrist, and threatens him when he resists.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie and Heather Glenn are good friends, and Kirsten sets Heather up with Matt Murdock.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Heather Glenn is a therapist who dates Matt Murdock after Kirsten McDuffie sets them up. They break up, and she goes on to serve Wilson Fisk.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Bastian Cooper, the serial killer Muse, becomes obsessed with therapist Heather Glenn and her book. He goes to her as a patient, then attacks her, and she kills him.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Heather Glenn counsels Vanessa and Wilson Fisk through their marriage troubles, including Vanessa's affair with Adam, and comes to worry about Vanessa as the strain grows.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Heather Glenn becomes the couples therapist for Wilson Fisk and his wife Vanessa, helping them work through Vanessa's affair. After her ordeal with Muse, she joins Fisk's administration, carrying out mental evaluations for his crackdown on vigilantes.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Kirsten McDuffie and Matt Murdock defend Hector Ayala when he is charged with killing a police officer.

stages.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1
stages.text: Matt Murdock defends Hector Ayala in court and outs him as White Tiger to win the case. The two come to respect each other as fellow vigilantes.

stages.text: Hector Ayala is Soledad Ayala's husband. He saves up to move them into a home of their own before his arrest.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok

stages.text: Heimdall distrusts Loki and defies him when Loki takes Asgard's throne, so Loki freezes him in ice.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Years later Loki, disguised as Odin, strips Heimdall of his post, and Heimdall goes into hiding.

stages.text: When Malekith attacks Asgard, his cloaked ship slips past Heimdall's all-seeing gaze. Heimdall still brings down a Dark Elf fighter by himself, but he cannot stop Malekith from reaching the palace and killing Frigga.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Heimdall serves Odin for centuries as the guardian of the Bifrost.

stages.title: Thor
stages.text: Heimdall is the all seeing guardian of the Bifrost and one of Thor's most loyal friends.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: After hiding Asgard's people from Hela until Thor's return, Heimdall dies at Thanos' hands after sending the Hulk to Earth.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Heinz Kruger, a HYDRA spy, kills Dr. Abraham Erskine moments after Steve Rogers becomes a super soldier and flees with the last vial of serum. Steve chases him down through Brooklyn, but Kruger bites a cyanide pill rather than talk.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Hela is Odin's firstborn and Loki's adoptive sister, and when she returns she nearly kills him. Loki later helps Thor unleash Surtur to destroy Asgard and Hela with it.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Hela is Odin's firstborn, who once helped him conquer the realms. He imprisons her when her ambition grows too great.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Hela spares Skurge when he claims to be a mere janitor and makes him her Executioner. He serves her during her conquest of Asgard, then turns on her army to protect the fleeing Asgardians, and she kills him.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Loki revives Surtur with the Eternal Flame to stop Hela, since only Ragnarok can end her. Surtur destroys Asgard and kills Hela along with it.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: When Hela returns to claim Asgard, Volstagg, Fandral and Hogun stand in her way. She kills all three of them with ease.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Hela is Thor's older sister, whom Odin locked away. She destroys Mjolnir and seizes Asgard, forcing Thor to unleash Ragnarok.

stages.title: Thor: Ragnarok
stages.text: Hela slaughtered the Valkyries long ago, and Valkyrie is the only one who survived. When Hela takes Asgard, Valkyrie faces her again to avenge her sisters.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: James joins Hive hoping to gain the powers Afterlife denied him, and with Hive and Daisy's help he finally becomes an Inhuman and takes the name Hellfire. He serves Hive under his influence until he is freed from it.

stages.text: James, the Inhuman Hellfire, turns on Jemma and Daisy when they come to warn him about attacks on Inhumans and sells them out to the Watchdogs. He tries to kill them both before Ghost Rider steps in.

stages.text: Jiaying catches James breaking into her private archives at Afterlife and banishes him before he can undergo Terrigenesis. He leaves bitter toward her and the whole community.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: Lincoln Campbell knows Hellfire, a loner named James, from their days at Afterlife. He takes Daisy Johnson to him for help finding a Kree relic.

stages.text: Lemar Hoskins and John Walker are sent after Helmut Zemo when he escapes from prison in Berlin.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Zemo kills T'Challa's father in the Vienna bombing and frames Bucky for it. T'Challa tracks him down, stops him from taking his own life, and hands him over to the authorities.

stages.text: Henry Lopez works for Wilson Fisk's criminal empire in Oklahoma, then turns against him to protect Maya.

stages.title: Echo
stages.text: Zane is one of Fisk's men who tries to kill Henry Lopez, and Henry kills him instead.

stages.text: Thor names Hercules as a possible recruit for his fight against Gorr. After Thor wounds Zeus in Omnipotence City, Zeus sends his son Hercules to hunt Thor down and kill him.

stages.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
stages.text: Hercules is the son of Zeus. After Thor humiliates Zeus, Zeus sends Hercules to kill Thor.

stages.text: Herman Schultz meets Mac Gargan on the Staten Island Ferry to sell him alien weapons from Adrian Toomes' crew. Spider-Man and the FBI break up the deal before it can close.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Ned Leeds helps Peter Parker against Herman Schultz with a web shooter.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Herman Schultz opens fire on Spider-Man during a botched weapons sale, then takes up the Shocker gauntlet after Brice is killed. He fights Spider-Man again on homecoming night and ends up beaten and arrested.

stages.text: Herman Schultz and Phineas Mason are part of Adrian Toomes' salvage crew, which turns to crime after Damage Control takes their job. Mason builds the alien weapons, including the gauntlet Herman wears as the second Shocker.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Herman Schultz is part of Adrian Toomes's crew, and he takes over as the Shocker.

stages.text: Lash comes to see his true purpose as killing Hive, and S.H.I.E.L.D. sends him after the Inhuman as a weapon. In his final attack he wounds Hive and frees Daisy Johnson from his control before Hive's follower Hellfire kills him.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3

stages.text: Hive kills Will Daniels on the planet Maveth and wears his body, which haunts Jemma Simmons.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3
stages.text: May rescues Holden Radcliffe from Hive's missile silo.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Radcliffe helps Jemma Simmons save May's life after a ghost's touch nearly kills her. Then he secretly replaces May with a Life Model Decoy and uses it to steal the Darkhold.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe helps Phil Coulson's team before his own plans with Aida take over.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe teams up with the Superior, Anton Ivanov, to find the Darkhold. He offers to get inside Billy Koenig's head and uses the Framework to pull the book's location from his memories.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
stages.text: Holden Radcliffe and Tucker Shockley work together for the Superior on the Watchdogs' submarine. Shockley throws Billy Koenig into a cell with Radcliffe, who poses as a fellow prisoner to win Koenig's trust.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Jeri becomes Hope Shlottman's attorney after Hope is jailed for a murder Kilgrave forced on her.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Hope's parents hire Jessica to find their missing daughter, and Jessica rescues her from Kilgrave. When Hope is jailed for the killings Kilgrave forced on her, Jessica fights to prove her innocence.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Kilgrave holds Hope under his control, rapes her, and forces her to kill her parents. Later Hope takes her own life so that Jessica will be free to stop him.

stages.title: Jessica Jones S1
stages.text: Trish Walker interviews Hope on her radio show to help clear her name.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Janet van Dyne is Hope van Dyne's mother, lost when Hope was a child, and Hope grows up without her.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Hope helps bring her mother home from the Quantum Realm.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Jimmy Woo leads the FBI's search for Hope and her father after they go on the run for helping Scott break the Sokovia Accords.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
stages.text: Hope van Dyne learns about Kang the Conqueror from her mother when her family is trapped in the Quantum Realm. She fights him at his citadel, and she and Scott Lang defeat him in the final battle over his Multiversal Engine.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Knox guards Sonny Burch during his deal with Hope van Dyne. When she attacks in her Wasp suit, he tries to shoot her, but she knocks him down.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Hope van Dyne trains Scott Lang to be Ant-Man, and the two fall for each other.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: After Scott's trip to Germany costs him her trust, they make up and fight together as Ant-Man and the Wasp.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: Sonny Burch sells Hope black market parts for the Quantum Tunnel under her alias. Once he learns who she really is, he tries to blackmail her and steal Hank's lab for himself.

stages.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
stages.text: When Uzman flees with the quantum part during Hope van Dyne's fight at Sonny Burch's restaurant, she chases him into the kitchen and knocks him out with an enlarged salt shaker.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Ivan Vanko blames Howard Stark for disgracing his father, Anton Vanko, and wants revenge on the Stark family.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Jack Thompson leads the SSR manhunt for Howard Stark when Howard is accused of selling his weapons. Once Howard is cleared, he makes Jack heap praise on him at a press conference, much to Jack's annoyance.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Howard Stark takes in Jason Wilkes while Zero Matter leaves him trapped and invisible, and the two scientists work together to cure him. They later team up to open a rift that will draw Whitney Frost out.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Johann Fennhoff blames Howard Stark for a massacre and hypnotizes him, sending him to drop a deadly gas over New York.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Joseph Manfredi and Howard Stark were childhood friends on the Lower East Side.

stages.title: Captain America: Civil War
stages.text: Maria Stark is Howard Stark's wife and the mother of Tony Stark. The Winter Soldier kills them both in 1991.

stages.title: Ant-Man
stages.text: Mitchell Carson works with Howard Stark at S.H.I.E.L.D. on a secret attempt to copy Hank Pym's Pym Particles. When Pym finds out and quits in 1989, Carson urges Howard not to let him leave.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Morgan Stark is Howard Stark's granddaughter, born to his son Tony and Pepper Potts long after Howard's death.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Obadiah Stane is Howard Stark's old friend and business partner, and he helps run Stark Industries with him. After Howard dies, Obadiah stays on to guide Howard's son Tony.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Howard Stark and Peggy Carter become close friends during the war.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: After the war, Peggy works in secret to clear Howard's name when he is accused of selling his weapons.

stages.title: Agent Carter (One-Shot)
stages.text: Together Howard and Peggy go on to found S.H.I.E.L.D., and Howard names her its head.

stages.title: Agent Carter S1
stages.text: Roger Dooley runs the SSR's hunt for Howard Stark and blames him for the deaths of his agents. Dooley digs into Howard's past at the Battle of Finow, but Fennhoff kills him before Howard is cleared.

stages.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
stages.text: Howard Stark helps turn Steve Rogers into Captain America, flies him behind enemy lines and gives him his vibranium shield. After Steve goes into the ice, Howard spends years searching for him.

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Howard Stark is Tony Stark's father, and they are distant while Howard is alive. Through an old film Howard left behind, Tony learns how much his father loved him.

stages.title: Avengers: Endgame
stages.text: Traveling back to 1970, Tony meets his father before he is born and makes peace with him.

stages.title: Agent Carter S2
stages.text: Howard Stark comes to Los Angeles to help Peggy Carter stop Whitney Frost and her Zero Matter. In the final fight, Howard and Edwin Jarvis run Frost down with a car.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Howard the Duck is one of the living exhibits in the Collector's museum on Knowhere. After the museum is wrecked, the two sit together among the ruins.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Hunter B-15 is C-20's fellow Hunter at the TVA. When the Variant ambushes C-20's unit in 1985 Oshkosh, B-15 leads the team sent after them.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter B-15 helps Mobius and Loki catch Hunter X-5 after he deserts the TVA to live as the actor Brad Wolfe, posing as a fan wanting his autograph so she can grab his TemPad. Back at the TVA, she locks him in holding until he talks about Sylvie.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Hunter B-15 arrests Loki for the TVA and has no patience for him at first. After learning the TVA's agents are variants, she helps Loki and Sylvie and fights with him to save the timeline.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Hunter B-15 and Mobius are longtime TVA colleagues who clash over his decision to trust Loki.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Once B-15 learns the TVA's agents are stolen variants, she and Mobius work side by side to steer the agency toward protecting the new branches.

stages.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
stages.text: Hunter B-15 is Mr. Paradox's superior at the TVA, and she shuts down his scheme.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter B-15 works with Ouroboros to keep the failing Temporal Loom running, and brings Casey in to help when the blast doors will not open.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Hunter B-15 serves Judge Ravonna Renslayer loyally and even shields her from Sylvie. After Sylvie unlocks B-15's memories, B-15 turns against Renslayer, who has her taken into custody and interrogated as a traitor.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Sylvie enchants Hunter B-15 at the Roxxcart, and the spell stirs memories of the life B-15 had before the TVA. B-15 later asks Sylvie to show her more, then turns on the TVA and frees Sylvie and Loki in front of Renslayer.

stages.title: Loki S2
stages.text: Hunter B-15 spots Victor Timely wandering the TVA and recognizes him as a variant of He Who Remains. She stands with Loki and Mobius as they convince him to help save the failing Temporal Loom.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Mobius M. Mobius finds C-20 traumatized in the back of a Roxxcart superstore. He questions her about the Variant who took her.

stages.title: Loki S1
stages.text: Ravonna Renslayer is C-20's superior at the TVA. After Sylvie's enchantment leaves C-20 broken, Renslayer interrogates her, and C-20 dies in TVA custody.
